Name: Simple Skills Extented
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#D8B4FE]✦ Simple Skills Extended ✦[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][b][color=#67E8F9]🌟 Level 10 was just the beginning.[/color][/b]
Keep growing long after your first profession choices. Simple Skills Extended adds powerful rewards to every level of Farming, Fishing, Foraging, Mining and Combat, with a [b][color=#D8B4FE]Level 100 main edition[/color][/b] and an optional [b][color=#86EFAC]Level 30 edition[/color][/b].
Earn lasting perks, collect additional professions and see exactly what your next level brings in a colourful Skills Journal.
The renamed continuation of Simple Mastery Expansion.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#FDE68A]✨ Features[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]• Automatic rewards at every earned level across the five vanilla skills.
• Extended progression beyond level 10, unlocked by reaching level 10 in all five skills.
• Additional permanent profession choices at levels 15, 20, 25 and 30.
• A Skills Journal with your current bonuses, upcoming rewards and the full level list.
• Per-farmer effect controls, available in the journal and optional Generic Mod Config Menu.
• Mouse, keyboard and controller navigation, with scrolling and responsive layouts.
• Integration with Simple World Tiers and Simple Experience Bar.
• Support for the vanilla Skills page and SpaceCore's Skills page.
• All twelve built-in game languages.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#D8B4FE]💎 Choose Your Edition[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][b][color=#D8B4FE]Level 100 — Main Download[/color][/b]
A long progression path with increasingly powerful rewards. Alongside the original skill benefits, this edition adds livestock production bonuses, seed refunds, connected ore-vein harvesting, expanded fishing treasure rewards, direct weapon damage and late-game death prevention.
High-level yields can exceed 100%: whole extra quantities are guaranteed, with a separate roll for any fractional remainder. This edition is intended for players who enjoy substantial long-term power growth.
[b][color=#86EFAC]Level 30 — Optional Download[/color][/b]
The original shorter progression path, with its own reward curve. Includes the level-by-level perks, additional profession choices, Skills Journal and effect controls, without the Level 100 edition's additional livestock, ore-vein and death-prevention systems.
Install [b]one edition at a time[/b]. Switching editions retains stored progression and earned professions; the Level 30 edition only displays and applies progression within its supported range.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#67E8F9]📈 How Progression Works[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]Early perks follow your ordinary unbuffed skill levels. Extended levels unlock once [b]Farming, Fishing, Foraging, Mining and Combat all reach level 10[/b]. You do not need Mastery level 5 or every Mastery Cave reward.
XP above level 10 is banked while that unlock is pending, then applied when you qualify. The Level 100 edition can also recognise overflow already recorded in your native skill XP. The Level 30 edition begins tracking new overflow when installed, while retaining existing mod progression.
Level 11 requires 1,500 overflow XP. Each following level costs 350 more than the previous one. Your journal shows the current progress and next target.
Perks activate automatically when earned. Additional profession choices appear after sleeping at levels [b]15, 20, 25 and 30[/b], letting you select a profession you do not already own. Multiple pending choices are retained safely.
Normal skill progression, temporary food buffs, the original level-5/10 choices and vanilla Mastery rewards remain available. Extended rewards are applied separately rather than treating the native skill formulas as literal level 100.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#86EFAC]🌱 Rewards Worth Growing For[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][b][color=#86EFAC]Farming[/color][/b]
Extra matching crops, fertilizer refunds, seasonal fertilizer retention, faster newly planted crops and quality benefits. The Level 100 edition also adds seed refunds and extra eligible animal products.
[b][color=#67E8F9]Fishing[/color][/b]
Shorter bite waits, tackle protection, reduced catch-progress loss, a larger fishing bar and extra eligible rod catches. The Level 100 edition expands treasure rewards and fish-quality benefits too.
[b][color=#FDE68A]Foraging[/color][/b]
More wood and hardwood, extra tree seeds, matching forage and appropriate seasonal forage. The Level 100 edition adds further forage-quality benefits.
[b][color=#D8B4FE]Mining[/color][/b]
More stone and ore, protection from your own bombs and improved eligible ladder chances. The Level 100 edition also rewards gems and unopened geodes, adds shaft benefits and unlocks connected ore-vein harvesting.
[b][color=#FDA4AF]Combat[/color][/b]
Extra ordinary monster-loot rolls, maximum health, faster melee swings, shorter special cooldowns and healing on eligible direct melee kills. The Level 100 edition adds direct weapon damage and death prevention from Combat level 50, with its own cooldown.
Rewards accumulate as shown in the journal. Bonus drops do not recursively reward themselves, and eligible quality improvements respect iridium and custom quality limits.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#FDE68A]📖 Your Skills Journal[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]Open the game menu, go to [b]Skills[/b], then select a vanilla skill or its level number. Controller users can select it with [b]A[/b].
Browse each skill's full reward list, inspect your current totals and next unlock, or use [b]My level[/b] to return to your progress. The journal uses coloured skill tabs, substantial native buttons and a scrollable layout that adapts to the window.
The [b]Effects[/b] controls let each farmer manage Mariner, Agriculturist, quality and crop-growth effects. Level 100 also provides controls for ore veins, animal yields and death prevention. Turning an effect off keeps its earned progression and profession ownership.
Generic Mod Config Menu is optional. Load your farmer's save before changing per-farmer effects. No extra hotkey is required.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#67E8F9]🤝 Working With Other Mods[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][b]Simple World Tiers (WIP - Coming Out Soon)[/b]
SSE supplies personal skill rewards; SWT supplies the farm's active tiers and recorded planting or encounter tiers. Resource bonuses add independently to the original native quantity, without multiplying each other's extras. Their ordinary monster-loot rolls also remain separate.
SSE crop growth joins native fertilizer and profession bonuses before SWT applies its whole-day reduction. Established crops retain their recorded schedules. Turning off an SSE growth or quality effect leaves SWT's own effect available.
[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53444]Simple Experience Bar[/url][/b]
SEB can display both supported extended-level editions, banked progress and profession-completion status. It is an optional display companion.
[b]SpaceCore[/b]
Supports displaying SSE information alongside SpaceCore's Skills page. SSE extends the [b]five vanilla skills[/b]; custom skills retain their own progression rules.
Mods replacing the same crop, fishing, resource or combat paths may need additional compatibility work. Quality, growth and other effect switches provide control where those systems overlap.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#86EFAC]📦 Requirements & Installation[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]• Stardew Valley [b]1.6.15 or newer[/b] on desktop.
• SMAPI [b]4.4.0 or newer[/b].
• Optional: Generic Mod Config Menu for in-game configuration.
1. Choose the Level 100 main download or Level 30 alternative.
2. Extract the [b]SimpleSkillsExtended[/b] folder into your game's [b]Mods[/b] folder.
3. Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.
Works with new and existing saves. Multiplayer participants should use the same version and edition.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#D8B4FE]🔄 Updating From Simple Mastery Expansion[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]Remove the old [b]SimpleMasteryExpansion[/b] mod folder and install [b]SimpleSkillsExtended[/b]. Keep only one SSE edition installed. SSE disables its gameplay hooks when the previous mod is also loaded, preventing duplicate rewards.
Existing extended XP, earned professions, pending choices, per-farmer effects and supported crop, animal and cooldown records remain readable through migration. Your existing save supplies those records; no manual save editing is needed.
Update Simple World Tiers to [b]1.4 or newer[/b] and Simple Experience Bar to [b]1.4 or newer[/b] if you use them, so their integrations recognise SSE's new identity.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#67E8F9]🌍 Languages[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]Follows your selected game language: English, French, German, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Turkish and Hungarian.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#FDE68A]🧪 Testing & Feedback[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]Automated checks cover both editions, rewards, progression, migration, native gameplay hooks, SSE/SWT integration and localized menus. Full live multiplayer and wider mod-combination testing remains ongoing; this release is suitable for beta testing.
For a report, include your SMAPI log, edition, relevant skill level and the other progression or gameplay mods involved.[/center]
